$comment: Database objects that live outside schema.prisma. The §15 drift gate (`prisma migrate diff --from-migrations … --to-schema …`) must ignore DROP/CREATE statements that touch these. They are created in hand-written SQL below the `-- nexus:managed-outside-schema` marker of a migration, or by the index.build job for generated columns (§6.2/§6.6).

patterns.$comment: Regexes over object names. Generated columns for Attribute.isIndexed are named gen_<attributeId with dashes removed> on "Record" with a matching btree index; RLS policies are named rls_<table>_tenant (Phase 1).
